attribution.evidence: All three audits found zero identity-overlap files, but each was invalid because cj0724.DEFAULT_TRAIN_MAT still pointed to the deleted C-drive baseline and the audit treats every unreadable historical train file as a hard failure.
attribution.boundary: This is not a model, output-equivalence, latency, data-generation, or identity-overlap result. The zero-overlap observation cannot be promoted because the full historical audit was invalid.

data_disposition.identity_disposition: quarantined_for_P5; no rerun, repaired audit, resume, selection, calibration, confirmation or test

failure_analysis: P5q fixed runner and MATLAB-generator relocation, as proven by unrelated-CWD tests and successful E-drive generation.
The relocation audit was incomplete: audit_p5g_shared_dense_data imports a globally hard-coded DEFAULT_TRAIN_MAT from cj0724.__init__, so its historical reference remained bound to C drive.
The failure occurred before CUDA and therefore consumed no GPU timing evidence, but the generated identities are still consumed by the failed frozen protocol.
next_allowed_action: A P5r successor may change only historical-baseline path resolution in the audit contract, require an explicit existing baseline plus SHA-256 receipt, retain P5q execution/checkpoint code unchanged, and use wholly new identities.
